rules: You resolve the space you land on. Spaces you pass do not fire, except Payday.
Payday adds your current salary when you land on it or pass it.
A stop ends the move even if steps remain. Then you spin again.
Ages 18 to 21 are a fork. Study and Work each have four spaces, then one shared track from 22 to 68.
At 68 the working track ends. Retirement choices are not in this version.

spaces.title: Tuition
spaces.detail: The bursar's window. Tuition is due in full before the year begins.
spaces.adapts: College path opening. Pay tuition up front. No gendered campus.

spaces.title: Long nights
spaces.detail: Reading, work, sleep, in that order. Nothing in the ledger moves.
spaces.adapts: College path year with no payday. Career would already be earning.

spaces.title: Internship
spaces.detail: A short paid stretch. Enough to eat, not enough to retire the debt.
spaces.adapts: Late college income, smaller than a career payday.

spaces.title: First role
spaces.detail: You stop. The study years are over, and a higher salary starts here.
spaces.adapts: Job Search stop. Guaranteed, like the classic red space. Higher pay than the work path.

spaces.title: First job
spaces.detail: You start earning now. The salary is lower, and it starts today.
spaces.adapts: Career path opening. Immediate job and salary. No degree gate.

spaces.title: Payday
spaces.detail: Collect your salary. The study path does not have this year.
spaces.adapts: Early Payday the career path reaches sooner.

spaces.title: Tools and transit
spaces.detail: Fares, boots, a bag that survives the week.
spaces.adapts: Early career expense.

spaces.title: Early raise
spaces.detail: A small raise, only if you land here. Passing through skips it.
spaces.adapts: Career growth you can miss if you do not land. Not a stop.

spaces.title: A room of your own
spaces.detail: Four walls and a lock. The first month is due.
spaces.adapts: First household setup after the paths merge.

spaces.title: Payday
spaces.detail: Collect your salary.
spaces.adapts: Payday. Collect salary on land or pass.

spaces.title: A friend's bill
spaces.detail: Someone you trust is short. You cover it.
spaces.adapts: Life-tile style good deed, settled in cash for this solo board.

spaces.title: Tax refund
spaces.detail: An envelope you did not expect. Small, and yours.
spaces.adapts: Small windfall.

spaces.title: Partnership
spaces.detail: You stop. Two people, one household. The gathering is small and costs what it costs.
spaces.adapts: Get Married stop. No spouse gender, no pink or blue pegs.

spaces.title: Household gifts
spaces.detail: People send what they can. A little cash, a lot of dishes.
spaces.adapts: Honeymoon beat, recast as gifts to the household.

spaces.title: A course
spaces.detail: Evenings, a fee, and a raise if you finish.
spaces.adapts: Night school. Optional, like a blue space.

choice.prompt: Pay $3,000 for a course that raises your salary by $3,000?

spaces.title: Car repair

spaces.title: A home

spaces.title: Housewarming

spaces.adapts: After the house, a small return.

spaces.title: Twins arrive

spaces.title: A quiet year

spaces.title: Retirement gate
spaces.detail: You stop. Working life ends at 68. This version ends with it.
spaces.adapts: Retire stop. No Millionaire Estates, no annuity, no decumulation.
